title: Immunogenicity and Safety Study of the 13-valent Pneumococcal Polysaccharide Conjugate Vaccine in 2-71 Months Old Healthy Infants and Toddlers (the Youngest Could be 6 Weeks Old)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate and valuate the immunogenicity and safety of the 13-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide conjugate vaccine in 2-71 months old healthy infants and toddlers (the youngest could be 6 weeks old)
condition: Diseases Caused by Streptococcus Pneumoniae Serotypes
